flash_697342.description:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) announced that it carried out a strike in Bahrain, which it claimed targeted a US military early warning system.

According to the IRGC, the strike was carried out in retaliation for an American attack on a communications tower in Sirik, Iran.

flash_697341.description: The Houston Astros hire former Team Israel manager Brad Ausmus, making the longtime MLB catcher the league's only active Jewish manager as he returns to his former team.

flash_697339.description: The US Department of Justice announced that it has not yet reached a definitive conclusion on whether Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a romantic relationship with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, engaged in espionage on behalf of Beijing.

flash_697337.description: Following the sirens that sounded a short while ago in the area of Nahal Oz, it was determined to be a false identification, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.

flash_697335.description: IDF on sirens in Nahal Oz: The details are under review

flash_697333.description:
US President Donald Trump commented in an interview on the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, saying he had last spoken with him on Wednesday. Addressing suspicions that Alice Huang, one of the women with whom Huang had a romantic relationship, had spied for China, Trump emphasized that the allegations had not been proven.

Huang, 63, resigned following revelations of an intimate relationship with another employee at the company, in addition to two previously disclosed extramarital affairs, including his relationship with Alice Huang, who is suspected of spying for Beijing.

flash_697332.description: Former Vice President Mike Pence challenges JD Vance's criticism of US support for Israel, warns of antisemitism, and disputes his explanation for GOP losses.

flash_697331.description:
A woman in her 50s was seriously injured after falling from a height on Highway 35, near Moshav Berekhya.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics and EMTs treated her at the scene before evacuating her to Barzilai Hospital in Ashkelon.

flash_697329.description: Two members of France's Republican Guard faint during President Macron's welcome ceremony for Slovakia's president at the Elysee Palace. Both are reported safe.

flash_697372.description: Over 8,600 trucks deliver winter supplies to Gaza, while COGAT and international partners coordinate medical aid and repairs to water and sewage systems.

flash_697371.description: After bereaved mother Esti Yaniv's painful remarks, Rabbi Yaakov Yakir opposes a government backed by Arab parties, criticizes Kobi Richter's political role and urges former classmate Matan Kahana to choose Jewish unity at this decisive moment.

flash_697369.description: Following shooting incidents and criminal activity in southern Israel, district police commander orders snipers deployed on rooftops in Rahat.

flash_697367.description: Why would anyone deliberately destroy a source of water in a land where every drop counts? Something remarkably similar happened in Gaza in 2005, after Israel withdrew from the territory and expelled its Jewish communities.

flash_697365.description: Religious Zionist rabbis seek to expand assistance for religious soldiers, formulate joint position in dealings with IDF on mixed-gender service.

flash_697363.description: Shlomo Kook questions how election results can cause a "crisis of faith". He says Jewish faith has survived repeated persecution and needs no stamp of approval from any political bloc.

flash_697361.description: In a video column on Arutz Sheva, Dr. Chana Katan criticizes shifting political positions on conscription, stressing an unchanged security need: more IDF combat soldiers and a fairer sharing of the burden.

flash_697359.description: In interim ruling, Supreme Court allows Rabbi Markovitz's followers to remain at Ponevezh until August 2027, subject to a commitment to vacate and payments totaling millions of shekels.

flash_697357.description: Speaking to American influencers in Peduel, Israel’s Consul General in New York Ofir Akunis calls Judea and Samaria Israel’s 'protective shield.'

flash_697355.description: During a search of the Azazmeh compound, Border Police officers found a loaded handgun concealed on a 20-year-old woman and NIS 315,000 in cash in the home.

flash_697353.description: Miriam Bracha Ben Hamo, 40, a mother of eight from Modi'in Illit, dies at Sheba Medical Center after suffering an amniotic fluid embolism during childbirth at Mayanei Hayeshua Medical Center.

flash_697351.description: Non-Jews who follow Jewish law gather in Israel for first international Noahide congress.

flash_697349.description: Why do we allow the presence of a fifth column in our midst? Will the ideal of democracy lead to the dismantlement of the Jewish state? Arab armies need not overwhelm us from the outside if we can be overthrown from the inside. Opinion.

flash_697347.description: Trump says Gulf states and Israel favor a slower approach to Iran, but warns he could destroy its energy, bridges and manufacturing infrastructure in three days.

flash_697345.description: Iran has turned its weakness into strength because America has turned its strength into weakness. Opinion.

flash_697343.description: The Nakash brothers sign an agreement to sell control of Arkia to a group of investors, hours after the Histadrut declared a labor dispute at the airline.

flash_697381.description:
Axios reports Mossad chief Roman Gofman meets senior US officials in Washington as Netanyahu presses Trump to resume strikes on Iran, despite the President's reluctance.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_227155.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 16:01 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 16:21 EST candle lighting time in New York.

The updates from Israel will resume Saturday night, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 17:19 in Jerusalem.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_697379.description:
Yashar! party chairman MK Gadi Eisenkot expressed his support for MK Elisaf Peretz and his family.

"I embrace Miriam Peretz, and I trust Elisaf. I know that he trusts me and the decisions I make, and will continue to make," Eisenkot wrote.

Eisenkot said that some members of his party and their families, including bereaved families, have been receiving thousands of harsh and abusive messages.

"People are entitled to disagree and criticize, but there is no place for incitement or threats," he stressed. "If anyone has a problem with the path I am setting, I am the one they should direct their criticism toward."

flash_697377.description: I needed to write about these people this week. I’ve spent enough evenings putting my phone down angry and picking it back up ten minutes later to find something else to be angry about. Op-ed.

flash_697375.description: Capt. Yonatan Ben Hamo and his wife, Oriya, became parents at Shamir Medical Center, three years after he was wounded in combat. He said, "We are here to stay".

flash_697373.description: One thing that won't help is blaming Bibi: Americans who trash Prime Minister Netanyahu don’t revile him because he is the prime minister but because he is the prime minister of the Jewish State. Removing him will not affect antisemitism. Opinion.

flash_697370.description: Minister Orit Strock sharply criticizes the Board of Peace and its head, Nickolay Mladenov, saying the new demilitarization plan meets Hamas's demands and leaves weapons in Gaza. She urges Israel to block it and insist on full demilitarization.

flash_697368.description: The pre-Islamic Near East can thus be considered, within the symbolic geography of Genesis, a meeting place of Ham and Shem.

flash_697366.description: On 24 Cheshvan 5787, sixty people signed a scroll in Jerusalem. They now have a morning after, and the work has already begun.

flash_697362.description: Ashkelon's hesder yeshiva honored second-year IDF recruits. Netael Yehuda Rosenberg completed the Babylonian Talmud, which he began studying in 10th grade. Rabbis blessed the recruits, emphasizing Torah study alongside military service.

flash_697360.description: Special event to be held in Bnei Brak on Saturday night, during which grants totaling NIS 147,000 will be distributed to yeshiva students who were held in military prison.

flash_697358.description: Police notice Palestinian Arab man wearing military boots, search of his home uncovers classified map of the Gaza border area, knives and an airsoft pistol.

flash_697356.description: Former Mossad official Haim Tomer agrees with former Mossad chief Dadi Barnea's warning, but believes a nuclear deal with Iran is preferable to having no agreement.

flash_697354.description: Microsoft outages persist this morning, affecting Outlook, Teams and Microsoft 365. Globes said its website and app are not updating due to the outage. Microsoft said repairs were not progressing as expected after detecting infrastructure overloads.

flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 17:19 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_697387.description:
Adult education program at George Mason faces criticism over a course on Palestinian history taught by an activist who joined an anti-Israel Gaza flotilla.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_697386.description:
US personnel were forced on Friday to take shelter at RAF Lakenheath, a major base hosting American forces in the UK, following "suspected unauthorized drone activity", reported Sky News.

No one was affected, nor was any aircraft. The incident came after the US military on Monday evacuated more than a dozen warplanes from a second, sprawling airbase in Suffolk, RAF Mildenhall, amid reports of a security threat linked to Iran.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_697384.description:
Turkey and Qatar sign a mutual defense agreement as Iranian attacks threaten Gulf states, strengthening their military partnership amid growing regional tensions.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_697382.description:
The IDF and Shin Bet say they eliminated more than 10 terrorists in Gaza over the past week, including Hamas terrorists who participated in the October 7 massacre.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_697380.description:
IDF soldiers, directed by the ISA, completed several operations overnight (Friday) in the Menashe Brigade area, during which they apprehended four terrorists.

The terrorists apprehended were involved in advancing terror attacks against Israeli civilians and security forces, including two terrorists affiliated with the ISIS terrorist organization.

The terrorists were transferred for further questioning by the security forces.

flash_697378.description: Tehran Province recorded 58,355 births in first seven months of the Iranian year, while deaths rose more than 6% from a year earlier, Tasnim reports.

flash_697374.description: Bat Yam resident, age 32, arrested on suspicion of involvement in the murder of an 85-year-old Israeli professor in Bulgaria, following the issuance of an international arrest warrant.

flash_697364.description: Strengthening maritime partnership between Israel and United States, Commander of the US Fifth Fleet visits Israel.

flash_697385.description:
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defies Iranian death threats after moving to a military base, saying US economic pressure is working and Tehran will seek a deal.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_697383.description:
MK Ahmed Tibi displays alleged messages from Netanyahu associate Natan Eshel, claiming the Prime Minister sought to influence the Joint List after the elections.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_697376.description: The commander of the Judea and Samaria Division and local authority heads met in Ariel to discuss community defense, infrastructure and cooperation between the IDF and local communities.

flash_697410.description: Two oil tankers caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine, the Iranian Navy said Saturday.

flash_697409.description: The American Heritage capsized in the Mississippi River after a tanker struck it at the dock; none missing or critical.

flash_697407.description: Two political upheavals in one week elbowed Israel to the cusp of not being reckoned among the nations. Opinion.

flash_697405.description: MK Yitzhak Pindrus of United Torah Judaism says he believes Shas would join an agreement on military conscription, Shas quickly rejects remarks.

flash_697403.description: The Muslim Brotherhood’s long strategy is a threat to American Jews. Read the story of an insidious plan.

flash_697401.description: Jerusalem District Court orders Karim Khan, former prosecutor of the International Criminal Court in The Hague, to pay compensation to Eitan Mor and the families of Avinatan Or and Omri Miran.

flash_697399.description: Iran nuclear expert Avner Vilan flags another Isfahan enrichment site reported before Operation "Rising Lion". IAEA inspectors had no time to check it; any enriched material there remains unconfirmed. He warns against aerial-only monitoring.

flash_697397.description: Warning of 'pre-Holocaust vibe' on social media, E Street Band guitarist Steven Van Zandt is using songs by KISS and Leonard Cohen to teach students about Jewish heritage and the Holocaust.

flash_697395.description: Somerville’s City Council votes 10-1 to bar contracts with companies it deems complicit in humanitarian law violations, opponents say the ordinance singles out 'Israel and Palestine.'

flash_697393.description: Rebbetzin Naama Perl tells Arutz Sheva's Dr. Chana Katan about her husband Rabbi Menachem Perl's psychological trauma following his work at Shura, her longing for the man he was and how she found a way to preserve her own strength.

flash_697391.description: In a new video, the Habayta Forum warns of a security threat in Judea and Samaria and urges scrapping the Oslo Accords and settling open land in Areas A and B to prevent another massacre. It calls on leaders to act before it is too late.

flash_697389.description: Lina Qassem (Zidan), about 60, killed by fragmentation grenade thrown by unidentified assailants at a business in Kafr Manda.

flash_697426.description: Jay Shapiro urges Netanyahu, Bennett, Eisenkot and Liberman to form a unity government, arguing that personal rivalries outweigh ideological differences.

flash_697425.description: SpaceX successfully catches its Starship spacecraft after 22 hours in orbit, marking a major breakthrough in reusable spaceflight despite a booster failure.

flash_697423.description: Samir Abu Yunis, the newly appointed commander of the Rafah Brigade in Hamas's military wing, was killed in four strikes targeting a refugee tent where he was staying west of Khan Yunis.

flash_697421.description: In Midrashic homilies, the pig came to represent Rome -- Esau's descendants. Can they ever fully repent?

flash_697419.description: More than 85,000 new homes remain unsold as sales slow, and the Housing Ministry’s director-general expects prices to fall further.

flash_697417.description: A British investigation reveals that Mayssoun Nassar, who has taken up a senior role at the BBC, described Israelis injured by rockets as "settlers" and Beersheba as an "occupied" city.

flash_697415.description: Iranian state television has warned that modified versions of the country's Khorramshahr ballistic missile could reach American military installations in Europe.

flash_697413.description: After a nationwide ground stop, Sean Duffy blames years of underinvestment, while Democrats question the administration’s response.

flash_697411.description: Kremlin says Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin will hold talks on November 19 on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

flash_697408.description: Tasnim suggests Tehran could develop missile capable of reaching US, following directive attributed to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

flash_697406.description: Twelve senators want to curb an expanding defense partnership. American troops and taxpayers could pay for their shortsightedness. Opinion.

flash_697402.description: MK Elisha Medan has announced plans to pitch a tent outside the Knesset and stay there until he succeeds in bringing about the formation of a broad-based government.

flash_697400.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called on the leader of the Yashar! party to join him for closed-door talks, without preconditions, to reach agreements on forming a unity government.

flash_697398.description: Heavily pro-Israel Argentine President Javier Milei faces a sharp decline in public support, partly due to rising unemployment in his country.

flash_697437.description: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa says she will reverse the state's terrorist designation of CAIR, challenging a measure imposed by outgoing Governor Greg Abbott.

flash_697436.description:
The Brooklyn Nets and Israeli forward Danny Wolf suffered a 129-110 defeat to the Memphis Grizzlies in NBA action Saturday night. The loss dropped Brooklyn's record to three wins and nine losses.

Wolf finished the game with 14 points, six rebounds, and one assist.

flash_697434.description: Sen. John Fetterman warns he could leave the Democratic Party if Chris Van Hollen becomes Senate Majority Leader, citing his hostility toward Israel.

flash_697432.description: Temple Talk explores the Ethiopian Jewish holiday of Sigd, its connection to Jerusalem and hopes for rebuilding the Holy Temple, while welcoming the month of Kislev and revisiting Jacob and Esau’s struggle over the birthright.

flash_697430.description:
Hamas' military wing confirmed that Samir Abu Younis, the terrorist organization's Rafah Brigade commander, was eliminated overnight in a strike in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Yunis, Reuters reported.

According to Hamas, Abu Younis was involved in planning the October 7 terrorist attack and overseeing its execution.

flash_697429.description: Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot plans to invite Likud into a unity government under his leadership, potentially offering Netanyahu a special diplomatic role. The Religious Zionist Party will also be approached.

flash_697427.description: An off-duty Border Police officer opens fire on a driver who endangered pedestrians and the officer himself in Acre. Driver seriously injured.

flash_697424.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the elimination in Gaza in a post on social media, "The IDF continues to eliminate Hamas leaders in Gaza, and another one has joined his predecessors in the depths of hell."

"The offensive policy that I am leading together with the Prime Minister and the IDF in Gaza will continue until Gaza is demilitarized and Hamas is no more," he added.

flash_697422.description: You push through resistance, excuses, and business pressures to reach the wellspring. And you grab the lifeline and hold on with glee.

flash_697418.description: Today Jacob must increase his voice and must don the gloves of Esau to eliminate through absolute strength and deterrence every vestige of terror in its midst.

flash_697416.description: Two-year-old wanders off while his parents check in for a flight to Larnaca, is found unharmed on the conveyor belt.

flash_697414.description: India's counterterrorism unit arrests young man suspected of gathering information on Chabad House and Jewish institutions in Mumbai, passing it to parties outside the country.

flash_697412.description: Medline receives reports of 35 serious injuries as well as seven deaths associated with potential fire and entrapment hazards, issues updated guidance for customers.

flash_697467.description: Traffic police stop a woman caught praying from a book with both hands off the wheel, warning her of the danger as part of a road safety operation.

flash_697466.description: According to a Haskupim X post, a taxi operated by a leading company serving the Haredi community struck two Hasidic children on Friday evening.

flash_697464.description: In an interview with Arutz Sheva, Elisha Medan responds to claims that he is Netanyahu's political tool and acknowledges the distrust between the camps, saying, 'I personally am prepared to do anything.'

flash_697462.description: Developed from pioneering research led by Clalit Health Services - Beilinson Hospital, ALZAI Health and Ariel University, the new AI model is marking a major step toward earlier Alzheimer’s risk detection

flash_697460.description: Ariel Eliyahu's son was named Yedidya Lev after the newborn's uncle, Yedidya Eliyahu, who was killed in battle, during a circumcision ceremony at the hesder yeshiva in Safed.

flash_697458.description: New York-based haredi entrepreneur Ezra Ungar has made a rival bid for control of Arkia, including a $30 million injection, employee board representation and protection from layoffs. His main condition: ending Shabbat flights.

flash_697456.description: 'We are going to turn Texas red again,' Sen. Ted Cruz predicts multiple Trump impeachments, vows to reclaim Texas for Republicans, and leaves open a 2028 presidential bid.

flash_697454.description: A Russian investigation has revealed another grandson of Vladimir Putin, whose father shares the Ukrainian president's surname. The birth registration raised questions.

flash_697452.description: Religious Zionism's faction chairman joined the unity tent at the Knesset and called on Netanyahu and Eisenkot to begin negotiations, "Unity will come at a price and require compromises".

flash_697450.description: Prosecutors are considering indicting Petah Tikva Mayor Rami Greenberg on suspicion of receiving more than NIS 1 million in bribes, pending a hearing.

flash_697448.description:
Jerusalem Border Police officers discovered eight individuals illegally entering Israel who were hiding inside a large fuel tank loaded onto a pickup truck at the Tunnels Checkpoint over the weekend.

The officers stopped the vehicle for inspection after it aroused their suspicion. During the search, they discovered the eight individuals concealed inside the tank, allegedly attempting to enter Israel illegally.

The eight suspects and the vehicle's driver, a resident of eastern Jerusalem, were arrested and taken for questioning at the Jerusalem District Police's Moriah station.

The driver was brought before a court, which extended his detention until Monday (November 16).

flash_697447.description:
Bahrain officially confirmed that Iran launched an attack on its territory last night. According to a statement by Bahraini authorities, the aerial targets that penetrated its territory were intercepted and destroyed.

The Iranian Revolutionary Guards claimed to have launched six drones at an American radar in Bahrain. This is Iran's second attack on Bahraini territory in recent days, after a lull of several months in Iranian attacks against the Gulf states.

flash_697446.description:
The Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, commented on the unveiling of Iran's new missile city and emphasized its strategic significance.

According to him, "This important achievement goes beyond a mere technical and security matter; it is a symbol of a change in the strategic equations in the region."

flash_697444.description: A northern Israel resident allegedly contacted Iranian intelligence operatives on his own initiative, offering to carry out espionage missions for ideological reasons and a desire for revenge.

flash_697442.description: The greatest danger of rising antisemitism is how easily yesterday's outrage becomes tomorrow's normal.

flash_697440.description: The IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Samir Abu Younis, who replaced the brigade's previous commander following his elimination in September.

flash_697438.description:
The Iranian Revolutionary Guards announced that they used six drones to attack a radar of an American air defense system at the Al-Rifa'a helicopter base in Bahrain.

According to the organization, the attack was carried out in response to "hostile" actions by the United States.
